q: Sistem elektrik terhasil apabila:
c: Elektron terlepas daripada atom dan dihantar melalui litar
e: What is electricity: electrons spin around the nucleus and are easily broken away; when sent on a circuit, we have an electrical system.

q: Dalam faktor yang mempengaruhi elektrik, 'Volt' ialah:
e: Ohm's Law: Volt – force of electric energy; Ampere – actual flow; Ohm – resistance of the circuit.

q: Arus 0.05 – 0.1 A melalui badan manusia boleh menyebabkan:
c: Lumpuh pernafasan dan kekejangan otot yang teruk
e: Effect: 0.001 perception; 0.01–0.02 muscle contraction, painful shock; 0.05–0.1 respiratory paralysis, severe spasms; 0.1–0.2 ventricular fibrillation; >0.2 severe burns, cardiac arrest.

q: Arus melebihi 0.2 A boleh menyebabkan:
c: Lecur teruk, serangan jantung dan kematian
e: > 0.2 A: severe burns, cardiac arrest, death.

q: Rintangan kulit manusia yang KERING ialah:
e: Body resistance: dry skin 100,000–600,000 Ω; wet skin ≈1,000 Ω; hand to feet 400–800 Ω; ear to ear ≈100 Ω.

q: Rintangan dalaman badan dari tangan ke kaki ialah:
e: Internal body – hand to feet: 400–800 ohms.

q: Ambang voltan minimum untuk mula merasa sakit pada 50 Hz ialah:
e: Voltage shock threshold at 50 Hz: feel 10–12 V; pain 15 V; excessive pain 20 V; voltage grip 20–25 V.

q: Elektrik amat berbahaya kerana ia:
c: Tidak dapat dilihat, didengar atau dihidu
e: Why it matters: electricity is invisible, fast-acting, potentially deadly; cannot be seen, heard or smelt.

q: Peraturan yang dikawal selia oleh Suruhanjaya Tenaga termasuk:
c: Peraturan Pengurusan Tenaga Elektrik dengan Cekap 2008
e: Energy Commission regulates ESA 1990, Electricity Regulations 1994 and Efficient Management of Electrical Energy Regulations 2008.

q: Piawaian IEEE 1584 berkaitan dengan:
e: Standards: NFPA 70E; OSHA 1910 Subpart S; IEC 61851/62196 EV charging; ISO 26262 automotive; IEEE 1584 arc flash hazard calculations; NESC utilities.

q: Mengendalikan penjana siap sedia (standby generator) dan UPS termasuk dalam aktiviti elektrik:
e: Operation activities: switching on/off, monitoring load and power quality, operating standby generators, UPS, controlling motor drives.

q: Menguji rintangan penebat, keselanjaran dan sistem pembumian termasuk dalam aktiviti:
e: Maintenance: routine inspection, testing insulation resistance, continuity and earthing, servicing breakers, replacing fuses.

q: Memasang semula pendawaian lama mengikut piawaian semasa termasuk dalam aktiviti:
e: Upgrading/modification: retrofitting old wiring, upgrading distribution, installing energy-efficient devices, modifying layouts.

q: Lecur elektrik boleh berlaku pada bahagian:
e: Electrical burns: caused by contact with live wiring; burns can be internal or external, affecting skin and tissues.

q: Percikan elektrik dalam atmosfera mudah letup seperti stesen minyak boleh menyebabkan:
e: Explosions: caused by sparks in explosive atmospheres (chemical plants, fuel stations).

q: Arka elektrik semasa penukaran suis gear voltan tinggi ialah contoh kemalangan semasa kerja:
e: During operation works: arc flash during switching of HV switchgear, shock from faulty control panels, burns from overheated busbars.

q: Lecur akibat penggunaan penguji rintangan penebat (megger) yang salah berlaku semasa kerja:
e: Testing & commissioning: arc flash from improper HV testing, shock from exposed test leads, burns from incorrect use of megger.

q: Bagi keselamatan elektrik, setiap litar perlu mempunyai pelindung litar seperti:
c: Fius dan pemutus litar yang sesuai untuk mengelakkan beban lampau
e: Safe use: 1 circuit protector – suitable fuse and circuit breaker to prevent overloading; 2 isolating switch labelled, reachable, lockable.

q: Pembumian (earthing) yang betul bermaksud litar disambung:
e: Earthing: for all electrical items; circuit is connected direct, not through a switch.

q: Pengajaran daripada kemalangan arka elektrik menekankan penggunaan:
c: Permit kerja dan LOTO bagi tugas berhampiran pemasangan elektrik hidup
e: Lesson learnt: risk assessment, isolation/de-energization, safe work procedures & permit systems (work permits, LOTO), arc-rated PPE, insulated tools, training, emergency preparedness.
